name: 47708 · Evansville, IN
findings: ZIP 47708 (Evansville) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47708 (Evansville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 47708 (Evansville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53.7 times the typical level).
